parameters.name: Digests
parameters.description: The SHA256 digest values of the images. Separate multiple SHA256 values with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Container Registry (ACR) instances. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: RegionIds
parameters.description: The region IDs of the images. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: RegistryTypes
parameters.description:
The types of image registries. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:

- **acr**
- **harbor**
- **quay**.

parameters.name: RepoIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the image registries. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: RepoNames
parameters.description: The names of the image registries. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

parameters.name: RepoNamespaces
parameters.description: The namespaces of the image registries. Separate multiple namespaces with commas (,).

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags of the images. Separate multiple tags with commas (,).
